What it is

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Suno's lyrics scroll - as the user scrolls down past the main player, a compact mini player drops from the top header; scrolling back up slides it away as the main player returns.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
A dark song page: header, large artwork, title "Afternoon Drip" with artist, transport controls (prev / play-pause / next), style description, then the full lyrics body scrolling beneath. The mini player is a slim bar pinned under the top header: artwork thumbnail, title and artist, and a circular pause button.

## Motion spec
Pattern: scroll-triggered sticky mini player dropping from the header.
- The page scrolls normally; the main player (artwork + transport) moves up with the content.
- When the main transport controls scroll fully under the header, the mini player drops in from above (spring ~340/26, ~60pt travel, 250ms) and stays pinned.
- The mini player's pause button mirrors playback state and toggles it (icon swap with a 150ms scale pop).
- Scrolling back up: once the main player re-enters view, the mini player slides back up and out (250ms, ease-in) while the main controls scroll back into place.
- The threshold is positional, not velocity-based: the mini player appears exactly when the main controls leave the viewport.

## Calibration
- One player is always visible: the handoff happens at the exact crossover, no gap, no overlap of both full controls.
- The mini player casts a thin bottom divider/shadow so lyrics passing under it read clearly.

## Reduced motion
Mini player fades in/out (150ms) instead of sliding.

## Don't miss
- The mini player inherits the page's dark blurred background, not an opaque bar.
- The title in the mini player matches the main player's title exactly, thumbnail included.
